anti_overlap: fd-personality-llm-legibility covers the prompt layer; this covers the ECS/Rust implementation layer
decision_lens: Implementation cleanliness — personality must integrate without requiring collect-then-mutate workarounds or system reordering cascades
focus: How personality components integrate with the existing ECS architecture and system pipeline
name: fd-personality-ecs-integration
persona: Rust ECS architect experienced with hecs, specializing in component composition and system ordering
review_areas: Evaluate whether personality should be a single component (Personality { introversion: f32, patience: f32, pride: f32 }) or separate components per axis
Check how many existing systems need modification to consume personality data (company_system, conflict_system, aspiration_system, satisfaction calculations)
Assess whether personality requires new system ordering dependencies or can slot into existing tick pipeline
Verify serde compatibility: #[serde(default)] for backward compatibility with existing saves
Check whether personality generation at spawn interacts correctly with the name generation pipeline (the brainstorm suggests name family biases personality)

severity_examples.condition: Query tuple grows beyond what hecs supports or misses the new component
severity_examples.scenario: Personality component added to spawn but not included in the 10-component query in state.rs from_world(), causing a runtime panic

severity_examples.condition: Two different components both modify the same need
severity_examples.scenario: Personality modifies company_system behavior but company_system currently reads AestheticPosition.social — dual-axis control creates confusing interactions

severity_examples.condition: Additive component field without serde default
severity_examples.scenario: Missing #[serde(default)] causes deserialization failure on old saves

success_hints: Personality integrates as a single additive component with #[serde(default)], consumed by 3-5 existing systems via minor modifications, no system reordering required.
task_context: The codebase uses hecs ECS with collect-then-mutate discipline. The previous sprint (syllable meanings) caught a silent feature-nullification bug where new fields existed but were never rendered to the LLM.
